native_retrieval.title: Energetic Exotics Launches Luxury Hospitality Partnership Program, Bringing Premium Mobility, Concierge, and Chauffeur Services Directly to Hotel Guests - markets.businessinsider.com
native_retrieval.snippet: # Energetic Exotics Launches Luxury Hospitality Partnership Program, Bringing Premium Mobility, Concierge, and Chauffeur Services Directly to Hotel Guests. *New partnership program enables hotels to elevate the guest experience through luxury vehicle rentals, executive transportation, chauffeur services, and personalized concierge experiences*. TAMPA, Fla., July 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Energetic Exotics today announced the launch of its Luxury Hospitality Partnership Program, a new offering designed to help luxury hotels, resorts, and boutique properties deliver world class transportation and lifestyle experiences to their guests. The program provides hotel partners with seamless access to a full suite of premium mobility services, including luxury and exotic vehicle rentals, executive transportation, professional chauffeur services, airport transfers, special event transportation, and personalized concierge experiences. The Luxury Hospitality Partnership Program offers a comprehensive suite of premium transportation and guest services designed to enhance the hospitality experience. As the Luxury Hospitality Partnership Program continues to grow, luxury hotels, boutique properties, resorts, and hospitality groups are invited to explore how premium mobility, chauffeur, and concierge services can enhance their guest experience.

native_retrieval.title: ED chargesheets self-styled godman Ashok Kharat in money laundering case - Telangana Today
native_retrieval.snippet: Home | News | Ed Chargesheets Self Styled Godman Ashok Kharat In Money Laundering Case. # ED chargesheets self-styled godman Ashok Kharat in money laundering case. The Enforcement Directorate filed a money laundering chargesheet against self-proclaimed godman Ashok Kharat, his wife and four others, alleging he cheated devotees by claiming divine powers and laundered illegal proceeds through cooperative credit societies and benami accounts across Maharashtra. **New Delhi:** The Enforcement Directorate has filed a money laundering chargesheet against self-proclaimed Maharashtra “godman” Ashok Kharat, his wife and others, alleging he cheated his followers by portraying himself as an incarnation of Lord Shiva and laundered the proceeds of crime through two cooperative credit societies. The prosecution complaint (chargesheet) was filed on Friday before a special Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA) court in Mumbai, naming Kharat, his wife Kalpana and four others as accused, according to an ED statement.

native_retrieval.title: BEST gets state nod to buy 5,000 self-owned AC e-buses | Mumbai news - Hindustan Times
native_retrieval.snippet: # BEST gets state nod to buy 5,000 self-owned AC e-buses. Mumbai: After a decade, the Brihanmumbai Electric Supply and Transport (BEST) undertaking has received the state government’s approval to procure 5,000 self-owned AC electric buses at an estimated cost of ₹6,500 crore, marking a major shift away from its dependence on the wet-lease model. “We have received the minutes of the meeting from the deputy chief minister’s office approving the procurement of 5,000 AC e-buses for our owned fleet. The buses will be self-owned, with drivers, as in the past, and will be procured at an estimated cost of ₹6,500 crore,” said Sonia Sethi, general manager, BEST. The procurement, expected to be completed over the next three to four years, is part of BEST’s long-term plan to build a fleet of 10,000 buses. Officials said BEST will now work on a financial model for the procurement, which is expected to be placed before the BEST Committee within the next month.

native_retrieval.title: New Prime Minister confirms his Cabinet - Public Sector Executive
native_retrieval.snippet: ## New Prime Minister Andy Burnham has confirmed the team that will make up his Cabinet, with some major changes to the Cabinet that was appointed by Sir Keir Starmer. Returning to the Cabinet are Louise Haigh, Angela Rayner, and Wes Streeting, who had been members of the first Starmer Cabinet that was appointed after the 2024 General Election victory. Haigh had previously held the role of Transport Secretary, however Andy Burnham has made her the First Secretary of State, Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster, and Minister for the Cabinet Office. Rayner, who resigned from the Cabinet in September 2025, returns to retake her position as Secretary of State for Housing, Communities and Local Government. Streeting had been Health Secretary under Starmer, however resigned from that position in May – a move that kicked off the challenge to the former Prime Minister’s leadership. Streeting has now returned to the Cabinet as the Secretary of State for Defence.

native_retrieval.title: BEST To Invest Rs 6,500 Crore In 5,000 Self-Owned Electric Buses, Plans 10,000-Bus Fleet To Reduce Dependence On Wet-Lease Operations - Swarajya
native_retrieval.snippet: # BEST To Invest Rs 6,500 Crore In 5,000 Self-Owned Electric Buses, Plans 10,000-Bus Fleet To Reduce Dependence On Wet-Lease Operations. BEST electric buses (BEST Bus Transport). The Brihanmumbai Electric Supply and Transport (BEST) undertaking has unveiled a long-term strategy to rebuild its own bus fleet, announcing plans to acquire 5,000 self-owned electric buses as part of a wider target of operating 10,000 buses across Mumbai over the next two to three years. The move marks a significant shift away from the wet-lease model that has dominated BEST's operations in recent years. Speaking after a BEST committee meeting, General Manager Sonia Sethi said the undertaking currently relies more on wet-lease buses than vehicles owned by the transport utility. While BEST currently operates around 2,800 buses and is set to induct 1,500 wet-lease electric buses under the Centre's PM e-Bus Scheme, officials said future fleet expansion will increasingly focus on company-owned vehicles beyond the scheme's support period ending in 2027.
